## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.25.1

This pre-release adds XR0A-iR Wi-Fi radon detector support for testers. It is not a claim of hardware confirmation.

### Radon Detector
- Creates Home Assistant entities for the XR0A-iR station, including battery, Wi-Fi, alarm, and end-of-life.
- Exposes the app home-card radon reading (`longTermValue`) in Bq/m³, plus 1/7/30/90-day averages, long-term day count, and peak radon.
- Applies house mainpage state when X-Sense keys the shadow as `XR0A-iR-{serial}` or the same pattern used by other house-state Wi-Fi stations.
- Keeps radon fields in diagnostics instead of stripping them from support dumps.

pCi/L remains a display conversion in the X-Sense app. Home Assistant values stay in Bq/m³.

This is a pre-release. Latest stable remains v1.4.25.
